name: Radiant Clarity
effect: Any Hit Points the potion restores gain a +2 bonus, and you shed Dim Light in a 5-foot radius for 1 hour.

name: Slow Release
effect: Every duration of the potion's effect is doubled.

name: Critical Instability
effect: If the vial is shaken hard, or its carrier takes 10 or more Bludgeoning damage in one hit, it bursts: each creature within 5 feet makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

name: Purging
effect: Drinking it also ends the Poisoned condition on you.

name: Grave Pallor
effect: Your skin turns ashen for 24 hours: you have Disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks but Advantage on saving throws against disease.

name: Deep Chill
effect: The potion never spoils, and you have Resistance to Cold damage for 1 hour after drinking it.

name: Lucid Dreaming
effect: While the potion's effect lasts (up to 1 hour), you have Advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

name: Banked Embers
effect: You gain 1d6 Temporary Hit Points, and you ignore the effects of extreme cold for 8 hours.

name: Wholesome
effect: When you drink it, you also regain 1d6 Hit Points.

name: Attuned Weave
effect: Dispel Magic can't end the potion's effect (an antimagic field still suppresses it).

name: Sunlit Draught
effect: Any dice the potion rolls to restore Hit Points use their maximum value, and you shed Bright Light in a 20-foot radius for 1 hour.

name: Ironwrought
effect: Every duration of the potion's effect is tripled, but the brew is so thick that swallowing it takes an action instead of a Bonus Action.

name: Bottled Thunderstorm
effect: When the vial is opened, roll a d6. On a 1, it explodes: each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much on a success, and the potion is lost. Otherwise, any dice the potion rolls use their maximum value.

name: Liquid Ruin
effect: So caustic it must be drunk through a glass straw. Drinking it any other way deals 3d6 Acid damage to the drinker.

name: Deathly Communion
effect: While the potion's effect lasts, you count as Undead for spells and effects (including Turn Undead), and you can't regain Hit Points except from this potion.

name: Heart of Winter
effect: You have Immunity to Cold damage for 1 hour, and the potion never spoils.

name: Mindstorm
effect: Visions pour in: make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, you have the Incapacitated condition for 1 minute before the effect begins. Either way, the DM grants you one cryptic vision.

name: Pyre-Heart
effect: Once within the next hour, when you drop to 0 Hit Points, you drop to 1 Hit Point instead and erupt in flame: each creature within 5 feet takes 2d6 Fire damage.

name: Wildbloom
effect: You also regain 2d8 Hit Points, and you're cured of one disease or of the Poisoned condition.

name: Wild Weave
effect: When you drink it, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table (Player's Handbook, Sorcerer).

name: Phase Separation
effect: It must be shaken for a full round (Utilize action) before use. Drunk unshaken, the bright top layer gives you the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Aurora Breath
effect: For 1 hour, your breath trails ribbons of green and violet light, giving you Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in Dim Light or darkness.

name: Sunfire
effect: For 1 minute, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage.

name: Photosynthesis
effect: If you drink it in sunlight, you also regain 2d4 Hit Points.

name: Dampened
effect: The syrup binds the restless humours: the potion never bursts or explodes from rough handling, and it keeps twice as long.

name: Sludge Congealment
effect: Forcing it down takes an action instead of a Bonus Action, and when the effect ends you gain 1 Exhaustion level.

name: Flash-Gelation
effect: It sets into a thick jelly in the vial and must be warmed over a flame for 1 minute before it can be drunk.

name: Soul-Scorch
effect: Your Hit Point maximum decreases by 1d8 until you finish a Long Rest.

name: Thermal Shock
effect: If the vial is dropped or thrown, it shatters violently: each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

name: Spore Burst
effect: Uncorking it releases a puff of harmless spores: every creature within 5 feet, you included, sneezes loudly.

name: Grave-Chill
effect: The potion never spoils, and you have Resistance to Necrotic damage for 1 hour after drinking it.

name: Ancestral Haunting
effect: You hear the whispers of the dead: make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Blight
effect: Life and rot fight each other: Hit Points the potion restores are halved, and you have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.

name: Cold Clarity
effect: For 10 minutes, you have Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions.

name: Tepid & Spent
effect: Heat and cold cancel out: the potion's dice and numerical bonuses are halved (round down).

name: Fey Reverie
effect: For 1 hour, you hear distant music no one else can, and small birds and beasts follow you around.

name: Lucid Weave
effect: For 1 minute, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you, as with Detect Magic (no Concentration required).

name: Wellspring
effect: When you drink it, you also regain one expended Hit Point Die.
